## Small everyday utilities

No download. Opens instantly, works offline.

## Your files never leave the tab

Open the network panel while a tool runs. After the model weights come down once, there is nothing left to see. No upload endpoint exists to send a file to.

Models execute on your graphics card through the browser's own runtime, not on a rented GPU somewhere.

Weights land in IndexedDB and OPFS on the first run, so the second run starts with no download at all.

There is no login and no usage meter, because there is no server cost per run to recover.

Whisper is MIT and Qwen3.5 is Apache 2.0. Each model is named where it is used.
